name: Crimson Girls 2
source:
The female detective team Crimson Girls attend a convention to investigate a request.

Mitsu, Arisa and Makino enter the convention hall. But before they can retreat, the trap is sprung!
All three girls are drugged. Mitsu gets spread on a table and lubed for assault. Arisa gets wrestled
into submission by two men in a mesh ring. Makino's hentai assailant torments her until she
can't resist any more...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ092576.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation: 女侦探团队“绯红少女”前往一场展会调查委托。Mitsu、Arisa和Makino进入展馆，但在她们撤退之前，陷阱突然启动！三个女孩都被下了药。Mitsu被摊开在桌上，涂满润滑剂后遭到侵犯。Arisa在铁网擂台上被两个男人制伏。Makino则遭变态袭击者折磨，直到再也无法反抗……[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ092576.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
